segments.text: Hello, my name is Judice. I'm from London. I've been asked to speak about my work that
I had done with Dr. Fulvio Correa. It was amazing. I had body 360. I am totally blown
away with the work. My experience was second to none. The nurses, one-to-one nurses were
unbelievable, very experienced and very professional. The aftercare was amazing
and the recovery house also was spotlessly clean and I just couldn't recommend it enough.
Absolutely a perfectionist and I highly recommend him.
